Say the Word on Beat

Sound file & timing

Load your track, press Preview, tap along to set BPM, and hit “Mark beat 1” on the first downbeat. With no file, a metronome click is used.

Using the built-in track (about 91.55 BPM). Every round replays it; tiles light from 0:05.6 to 0:29 at 2 tiles per beat, pausing between beep bursts.
